correctness.rationale: For each zero cell (i,j), its neighbor sum equals row_weight(i)+column_weight(j). An empty column forces every row weight >=2, otherwise every column weight >=1. Equality gives the complete A/B families and their overlap. The onto-map recoloring proof proves connectivity for n>m using 2- and 4-move swaps, while n=m consists of m! isolated permutations; within-row moves yield T_n powers for n>2m, and exact local counts yield degree and metric. These all-parameter arguments have been reconstructed; two attached independently organized Python programs directly corroborate small cases and strict-product regimes. Finite tests are not substituted for the proof.

originality.rationale: Closest exact-object published full text gives perfect rather than ordinary Italian domination on K_m square K_n. The constraint changes the optimum for m<n<2m, and the published values do not imply classification, reconfiguration or degree-diameter formula. Multiple actual database aliases, literature and accessible private historical claims were checked, with no dominating statement located. Two plausible full texts and an overview are incompletely accessible and named as residual risks; novelty is not independently certified.
residual_risks: The original 2016 foundational paper was not read in complete full text; accessible publisher material cannot establish whole-document noncoverage.
Klostermeyer and MacGillivray (2019) investigate Italian domination on several graph classes, but the full PDF was inaccessible; same-object exact values might have been published there.
The 2024 Roman {2} domination survey was only partially accessible; an unindexed equivalent classification or complete computational table might exist.
Publication priority and scientific correctness have not undergone independent external audit.
The dated 2016-05-11 bibliographic record is verified publicly, but possible earlier online-first source date was not established.

value.rationale: Full infinite-family optimal-label classification and counting at the sharp n=2m boundary have clear domination-theoretic meaning; the onset of optimal-state connectivity exactly at n>m and an explicit Cartesian-power reconfiguration geometry (degree spectrum, radius, diameter) for n>2m characterize how optimal defenses can be redistributed. This is not solely a routine graph minimum or arbitrary finite numerical slice.
